title: Spicy Chicken Tagine Tacos
description: A flavorful fusion of Mexican and North African cuisine, this dish combines the rich spices of a traditional tagine with the vibrant flavors of a Mexican taco.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the chicken with aromatic spices, tagine, and inflammatory spices.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add 1/4 cup of water to the skillet and cover. Simmer until the chicken is cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Shred the cooked chicken and season with egyptian cumin.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chicken onto a tortilla and topping with your desired toppings.
